name: Premium Concave Feather Flags
descriptionHtml:
Premium Concave Feather Flags

Make your brand stand out from every angle with our Premium Concave Feather Flags, designed for high visibility at outdoor events, trade shows, storefronts, and festivals. Featuring a sleek feather-style silhouette, these flags deliver strong visual impact and professional branding in both indoor and outdoor environments.

All flags are double-sided by default, ensuring maximum exposure, and are printed using full-color dye sublimation on premium poly knit fabric for vibrant, long-lasting graphics.

Key Features

🎏 Concave Feather Shape: Eye-catching feather-style design that moves naturally in the wind.
🎨 Double-Sided Printing Included: Graphics are visible from both sides at no extra cost.
📏 Available Sizes: Choose from 9ft, 12ft, or 15ft to match your visibility needs.
🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation: Artwork printed on white super poly knit fabric for rich, fade-resistant color.
🧵 Reinforced Edge Construction: Fiberglass pole pockets create a clean black outline along the flag edge.
💪 Flexible Fiberglass Poles: Strong, durable, and wind-resistant construction.
⚙️ Ergonomic Aluminum Collar: Polished aluminum pole segments for smooth assembly and stability.
🪨 Cross Base + Water Bag Included: Ideal for hard, flat surfaces both indoors and outdoors.
🔩 Multiple Mounting Options: Upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit to attach flags directly to a canopy tent.
🌬️ Wind Speed Rating: Designed to perform in winds up to 18–23 mph.

Materials

🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester
🧵 Flag Graphic: 110g Knitted Polyester
🔩 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass

Primary Usage

Outdoor advertising, trade shows, festivals, storefronts, farmers markets, brand activations, sports events, and canopy tent setups.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
